en.title: Modify Array
en.description:
Find the minimum total absolute modification cost to turn the array into a non-decreasing or a non-increasing sequence; each position may be changed to any integer value, at a cost equal to the absolute difference between the new and old values.

All extra constraints and the I/O format are additions by this site and do not claim to be the original platform's format.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers. The original constraints are 1≤n≤1000 and 1≤arr[i]≤10^9; this site widens the value range to 0..10^9 to keep the 0 in the third source example.
en.output: Output the minimum total modification cost over the two directions, as a 64-bit non-negative integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the boundaries according to the statement, then handle the validity or optimality conditions that are easiest to miss.
